name: nijl
prompt: Create an original educational PNG illustration for a Dutch first-grade worksheet question about the river in ancient Egypt. A broad blue river clearly dominates the foreground and winds into the distance, with narrow lush green banks, reeds and a few palms, golden desert beyond, and two small ancient Egyptian pyramids far in the background to locate the scene. No people. Friendly clean textbook illustration, clear warm outlines, natural flat colours and light shading, readable even printed at 4 cm wide. Landscape composition 3:2, river is the unmistakable main subject. No text, no letters, no river name, no labels, no border, no watermark. White sky/background.
